# Lab 02 - Abrir Chamado Técnico

Formulário de chamado técnico com os campos nome, e-mail, prioridade e anexo (PNG ou PDF).

O formulário envia os dados com `method="POST"` e `enctype="multipart/form-data"` para o `https://httpbin.org/post`, que devolve tudo o que recebeu. Assim dá para conferir se os campos e o arquivo chegaram.

## Resposta do teste

Os campos de texto aparecem em `form` e o arquivo aparece em `files`:

```json
{
  "args": {},
  "headers": {
    "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/jxl,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7",
    "Accept-Encoding": "gzip, deflate, br, zstd",
    "Accept-Language": "pt-BR,pt;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7",
    "Cache-Control": "max-age=0",
    "Content-Length": "34705",
    "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryZt6uzwH0ia5inuOf",
    "Host": "httpbin.org",
    "Origin": "null",
    "Priority": "u=0, i",
    "Sec-Ch-Ua": "\"Not-A.Brand\";v=\"99\", \"Google Chrome\";v=\"157\", \"Chromium\";v=\"157\"",
    "Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile": "?0",
    "Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform": "\"Windows\"",
    "Sec-Fetch-Dest": "document",
    "Sec-Fetch-Mode": "navigate",
    "Sec-Fetch-Site": "cross-site",
    "Sec-Fetch-User": "?1",
    "Upgrade-Insecure-Requests": "1",
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/157.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
  },
  "method": "POST",
  "origin": "200.143.198.66",
  "url": "https://httpbin.org/post",
  "data": "",
  "files": {
    "anexo": "data:application/pdf;base64,"
  },
  "form": {
    "email": "email@email.com",
    "nome": "karol",
    "prioridade": "Baixa"
  },
  "json": null
}
```
